scripture.verse: It is the spirit that quickens. The flesh profits nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life.
This I recall to my mind, therefore ha ve I hope.
When it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb and called me by His Grace, to reveal His Son in me.

sermons.title: Sermon 658 | From The Dunghill To The Throne

scripture.verse: He raises up the poor out of the dust and lifts the needy out of the dunghill, that He may set him with princes, even with the princes of His people.
And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. And the same man was just and devout, waiting for the Consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. And the earth was without form, and void. And darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters. And God said, Let there be light and there was light And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. And God called the light Day and the darkness He called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
Neither is there any mediator between us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
